content.Title: 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Valvular Heart Disease
content.Table Title: Criteria for Imaging Personnel and Institutional Facilities and Infrastructure

Personnel: Valve echocardiographer for pre- and postoperative assessment of valve disease
Expert in CT for preprocedural assessment of patients with valve disease
Valve echocardiographer for pre- and postoperative assessment of valve disease
Expert in CT for preprocedural assessment of patients with valve disease

Notes: Primary (Level II) Center can provide procedures of Comprehensive (Level I) Center if criteria are met.
Mitral valve anatomy is not suitable for valve repair if unfavorable imaging and surgical expertise are absent.
Institutional volume and mortality rate impact outcomes of cardiovascular procedures such as SAVR, TAVI, and other repairs.
